hero_tagline: Entrepreneur • Business Strategy Coach • Youth Mentor • Speaker
hero_title: Empowering the next generation of African entrepreneurs.
hero_desc: Coach, trainer, and speaker — I've mentored over 100 young entrepreneurs across Paris, Benin, China, and beyond. I don't just build products; I build the ecosystems, leadership, and strategic vision that make businesses thrive.
about_lead: It's the story of a young man who had the privilege of joining Junior Chamber International very early. This experience revealed his leadership abilities through training in project management, administrative planning, and public speaking.
about_body: It is truly this crucible of international youth that shaped his journey and gave birth to a vision: purpose life — living with a clear and impactful purpose. From a young age, he grew alongside great entrepreneurs and local leaders, interacting with creative minds and committed leaders. Very quickly, he took up the torch, with the will to build something bigger than himself. Today, he has already invested in several fields through digital solutions: financial applications (fintech), stock management systems, tools for processing industries, solutions for foodtech and restaurant management. Multiple solutions have been developed and are actively managed today.
about_visionary_desc: Leadership, strategy, and sustainable business models.
about_speaker_desc: Sharing insights on leadership, tech, and African entrepreneurship.
services_subtitle: Training, coaching, and strategic partnership for entrepreneurs, teams, and organizations.
service_strategy_desc: I guide founders through the entire lifecycle of their enterprise — from ideation to scaling. My approach goes beyond products and services to address the full ecosystem: leadership development, team structure, financial management, market positioning, and long-term sustainability.
service_mentoring_desc: I've mentored over 100 young people across Paris, Benin, China, and other regions on leadership, productivity, time management, economics, and personal finances. Whether you're a student, early-stage founder, or young professional — I help you unlock your potential and build habits that last.
service_speaking_desc: Available for conferences, panels, and workshops on topics including: African entrepreneurship, leadership in the digital age, technology and innovation, youth empowerment, and financial literacy. I bring real-world experience from the field to inspire and educate.
service_advisory_desc: I partner with companies seeking to attract investors, restructure operations, or develop tech-driven solutions. My background in software engineering and business strategy allows me to bridge the gap between technical teams and executive leadership.
service_venture_desc: Engineering new business models, rapid prototyping (MVP), and guiding startups to Product-Market Fit. I combine my technical expertise with business acumen to help founders build scalable ventures that solve real African problems.
testimonial_1: "Nehm doesn't just teach theory — he shares real battle-tested strategies. His coaching on leadership and time management completely changed how I run my startup. I went from chaos to clarity in just 3 months."
testimonial_2: "I attended one of Nehm's youth mentoring sessions in Paris and it was a turning point in my entrepreneurial journey. His approach to productivity and financial discipline is rare and incredibly valuable."
footer_slogan: Empowering Africa's Next Generation of Entrepreneurs.
portfolio_subtitle: Startups and strategic ventures co-founded and scaled across Africa's most promising sectors.
portfolio_usd_desc: International technology community that trains, supports, and connects young digital professionals — for free. Present across multiple African countries with bootcamps, workshops, and mentorship. Mission: democratize tech and uncover Africa's talents of tomorrow.
portfolio_waxle_desc: Complete digital platform connecting clients to local service providers of proximity. A modern and intuitive solution to quickly access various on-demand services via web and mobile app.
portfolio_fluxy_desc: Intelligent financial management platform empowering African SMEs with seamless payments, real-time cash flow visibility, and world-class accounting automation.
books_subtitle: Sharing knowledge to democratize entrepreneurial excellence across the continent.
books_scaling_desc: Release 2025 • The definitive guide for tech founders building scalable businesses in Africa's most complex markets.
books_scaling_desc_long: The definitive guide for tech founders building scalable businesses in Africa's most complex markets. From product validation to multi-country expansion, this book covers concrete strategies, mistakes to avoid, and proven frameworks for going from 0 to a sustainable company.
books_leadership_desc: Release 2024 • Mastering AI, remote teams, and the future of work in the African context.
books_leadership_desc_long: An essential book for Africa's leaders of tomorrow. How to master AI, manage remote teams, and adapt to the future of work in the African context. Practical tools for developing authentic leadership in the digital age, combining strategic vision and emotional intelligence.
books_programs_intro: Professional training programs designed for entrepreneurs, teams, and organizations across Africa.
books_training_leader_desc: Developing emotional intelligence, decision-making frameworks, and the strategic mindset needed to lead high-performing teams.
books_training_prod_desc: Master your workflow, eliminate distractions, and build systems that multiply your output as an entrepreneur.
books_training_fin_desc: Understanding financial literacy, cash flow management, and investment principles for young entrepreneurs.
books_training_eco_desc: Learn to design the complete business ecosystem — from leadership structure to financial sustainability.
resume_subtitle: A journey defined by action, certified expertise, and unwavering commitment to empowering Africa's youth.
resume_experience_subtitle: Consulting, technology, and leadership roles across multiple sectors and countries.
exp_google_desc: Recognized as a Google Cloud Innovator — contributing to cloud application development and AI-powered solutions for African businesses. Driving cloud adoption and digital transformation in the region.
exp_novatech_desc: Leading the development of an incident management platform via ticketing for CiteeGroup. Managing the full software development lifecycle — from architecture design to deployment. Contributing analytical insights and technical leadership across multiple projects including the company's live web platform.
exp_uac_desc: Digitizing all paper-based processes of the FSS academic affairs department via the SIMSCore (Student Information Management System) platform. Overseeing the Faculty's showcase website modernization. Supporting administrative process optimization and digital transformation.
exp_jci_desc: Leading external communication across all channels. Managing project planning, document sharing, and team coordination. Organizing events from invitations to online promotion. Monitoring actions and evaluating community impacts via reporting tools. Driving the digital presence and visibility of one of Cotonou's most active JCI chapters.
exp_harvard_desc: Completed 'How to Create a Climate Venture' — a structured entrepreneurship program by Harvard Innovation Labs for aspiring climate entrepreneurs. Mastered structured ideation for climate mitigation and adaptation solutions, developed and refined elevator pitches through iterative exercises, and acquired tactical validation tools including A/B waitlist testing and climate impact measurement frameworks. Engaged with ecosystem leaders including founders, investors, and funders through weekly sessions led by Rebekah Emanuel, Director of Harvard Climate Entrepreneurs Circle. Collaborated with a selective cohort of climate-focused entrepreneurs from Harvard, Stanford, MIT, and Dartmouth.
exp_usd_desc: Founded an international technology community that trains, supports, and connects young, passionate digital professionals — for free. Present in several African countries, USD's promotes mutual support, skills sharing, and equitable access to tech training. Through free bootcamps, hands-on workshops, mentoring, and collaborative projects, we prepare the next generation of developers, designers, and digital creators. Mission: democratize tech, create concrete opportunities, and uncover African talents of tomorrow.
exp_bestexp_desc: Worked as a Full Stack developer on digital solutions deployed on the market and used daily by hundreds of users. Maintained and improved Flutter mobile applications (Android & iOS) in production. Designed new features on the Laravel backend (RESTful API, user management, dashboards). Fixed bugs, optimized performance, and ensured stability of large-scale services. Participated in code reviews and agile sprint planning using Jira/Trello.
